answer_1.quote: We propose USP, a versatile and black-box automatic prompting method that can be zero-shot using only unlabelled data.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs on summarization (xsum, wikilingua), question answering (squad, web_questions, etc.), and word prediction (lambada), which are NLG tasks, particularly under SFG and LFG categories.
